phases.description: Configure development environment, initialize Node.js project, install necessary packages.
Implement the REST API logic in Node.js and Express for creating, listing, and deleting notes with in-memory storage.
Develop and execute unit and integration tests to verify API functionality and error handling.
Prepare the application for deployment, including any necessary scripts and documentation.

top_risks.risk: Potential memory exhaustion with large numbers of notes.
top_risks.mitigation: Monitor memory usage and set limits on the number of notes the application can handle.

top_risks.risk: Data loss on server restart due to in-memory storage.
top_risks.mitigation: Accept this limitation; ensure users are informed about data volatility.

estimate.summary: The overall effort level is moderate, largely driven by implementing and testing the core API logic. The primary risk involves potential memory issues with no persistent storage. Effort estimates assume basic setup and knowledge of Node.js and Express.
